plain: To bring back to life, or back into use

webster.text: To return to life; to recover life.

example.quote: In like manner a conclusion of peace annuls all the laws peculiar to a state of war, and revives the general laws incident to a state of peace.
example.cite: Alexander Hamilton (Pacificus) and James Madison (Helvidius), The Pacificus-Helvidius Debates, June-Sept. 1793
